h1: Turkey tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Turkey? This page explains the Turkey tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 150 days from arrival
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Turkey tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders don't need a visa to visit Turkey for tourism or business for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Your passport must be valid for at least 150 days from your arrival date.

sections.heading: What a Turkey tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Turkey tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Turkey. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Turkey business visa](/turkey-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents travelling on other passports may need a Turkey eVisa or a visa, depending on their nationality. Work and study in Turkey always need a visa.

sections.heading: Turkey tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Turkey tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Turkey.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Turkey tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Turkey tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Turkey on a Turkey tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Turkey tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
